s adam schefter reported saturday adding that multiple teams have reached out to indy and discussions are active and ongoing rapoport and schefter identified the denver broncos green bay packers minnesota vikings new york giants and seattle seahawks as clubs that have shown some level of interest in the three time pro bowler per sources it was previously reported that colts ownership didn t want to trade the star ball carrier but while the organization would still prefer for him to be part of its rebuild indianapolis trajectory is very much that of a trade deadline seller in fact the colts are ahead of schedule in that regard just this week with the nov 10 deadline still a ways away they shipped guard quenton nelson to the seahawks and defensive lineman deforest buckner to the 49ers wide receiver josh downs also requested a trade though his ask doesn t seem entirely necessary considering the colts are already wheeling and dealing anyway the moves come with the colts sitting at 2 5 having fired general manager chris ballard after a loss to the previously winless tennessee titans in week 6 taylor for his part recently said he s proud to be with the colts but acknowledged the possibility a trade might occur such a transaction would represent a seismic shift both for indianapolis and whatever team landed him taylor who has rushed for 587 yards and a league leading eight touchdowns this season has amassed 9 832 total yards and 84 tds over his seven year career he signed a two year 44 million extension just this august meaning the 27 year old wouldn t just be a rental for a club making a championship push he s an expensive addition third among running backs at 22 million per year but he s in his prime and under contract through 2028 any team would be made instantly better by adding him and after being reticent to part with him the colts have apparently opened the door a bit more to making it happen

material_news_signals.headline: Buccaneers' Todd Bowles on zero-completion win over Falcons: There's a 'first time for everything'
material_news_signals.description: The Buccaneers outlasted the Falcons in a rain-soaked affair despite Baker Mayfield attempting only three passes and converting on none of them, becoming the second team in the Super Bowl era to win a game without a single completion.
material_news_signals.body_text: conventional wisdom said baker mayfield would need to throw for more than the 64 yards he managed in last week s victory if the buccaneers hoped to begin a winning streak on sunday conventional wisdom was wrong tampa bay instead outlasted the falcons 16 0 in a rain soaked affair at raymond james stadium despite mayfield attempting only three passes and converting on none of them as the bucs became the second team 1974 bills in the super bowl era to win a game without a single completion i have not head coach todd bowles said when asked if he s ever won without a completion per the team s transcript but there is a first time for everything as noted it s the second such occurrence since the league merger but it s certainly a first for bowles who would ve been only 10 years old when the 74 bills accomplished the unthinkable feat a torrential downpour set the stage for such an odd accomplishment the falcons were especially affected by the storm attempting to throw their way through it to disastrous results michael penix tossed three interceptions in the first 18 minutes of the game frequently missing his pass catchers as he delivered a slippery football with little to no authority over its destination tampa bay conversely took to the ground again and again attacking an atlanta defense that entered the weekend fourth against the run i didn t say we were not going to throw the ball the conditions told him that bowles said when asked about game plan discussions with offensive coordinator zac robinson you could see it it s a downpour and the wind was blowing you can kind of see the ball wasn t going anywhere mayfield attempted his first pass with 7 53 remaining in the first quarter nearly a 28 yard touchdown that ted hurst dropped after throwing another pass with 4 10 left in the opening frame he wouldn t record another one until his third snap of the third quarter that was it there was a dropback in the second quarter during which mayfield had the ball slip out his grasp while trying to throw a good representation of the sloppiness that contributed to five fumbles and three ints between the teams but it was otherwise all runs the buccaneers simply didn t need to take any of the risks involved with airing it out further their defense was that stifling and their running game was that dominant bucky irving and kenneth gainwell gashed the falcons for a combined 310 rushing yards on 52 attempts on tampa bay s lone td drive the two combined to go 90 yards on six carries with both breaking off big runs irving for 46 and gainwell for 28 including mayfield s 14 rushing yards the buccaneers set a new franchise single game record with 324 it s winning that s the way i think about it mayfield said we won it s getting our guys lined up making sure we are running the right run plays obviously ball security is crucial in these conditions we had some early ones we decided to go to the shotgun and pistol sets it s just easier to receive the snaps instead of it coming back through your hands under center so going from there and just trying to manage the game it s time management and just trying to bleed the clock as much as possible just get everybody on the same page and go from there that s my job in these conditions and listen i will do whatever it takes to win that s all that matters to me offensive lineman luke goedeke who helped pave the way for tampa bay s historic rushing performance said of mayfield only attempting three passes yeah i mean it s great it s just a testament to the offense the o line the tight ends the wide receivers running backs it s just everyone doing their job and bake he hands off a mean ball so really hats off to him as well the buccaneers have now won two straight both against divisional opponents to inch back to 3 5 they re right in the thick of it in the nfc south knotted in the win column with the falcons 3 5 and panthers who sit atop the standings at 3 4 they ve still got a long ways to go and surely mayfield will be called on to pass a lot more than he did on sunday moving forward but the potential turnaround has begun on the strength of a punishing run game we did a lot to dig ourselves out of it bowles said of being back in contention for the division we re still in it being 3 5 not being 500 or anything else i told them to keep their shovels close because we have a lot more digging to do but it gets us back in it

material_news_signals.headline: New Bears DT Jeffery Simmons understands Super Bowl goal in Chicago: 'They want it right now'
material_news_signals.description: Jeffery Simmons has gone from cellar-dweller to title contender in one week. The magnitude of the moment was not lost on him when he learned he was leaving the Tennessee Titans for the Chicago Bears.
material_news_signals.body_text: jeffery simmons has gone from cellar dweller to title contender in one week the magnitude of the moment was not lost on him when he learned he was leaving tennessee for the chicago bears the trade told me everything i needed to know especially the value from giving away two first round picks simmons said friday i could also look on the other side of that and be like man i just got traded but i could also look at the bright side of things of this team believes in what they have here and they want it right now if a mid season acquisition wasn t enough to send such a signal the two first round picks the bears sent to the titans certainly did it was a bit out of character for general manager ryan poles who hasn t built his reputation on sending significant draft capital for an instant return but the circumstances called for it with quarterback caleb williams playing on a rookie contract and the bears title window being as open as it might ever be poles knew it was time to take a big swing with the hopes of hitting a lombardi trophy sized home run you do this type of move when you have a combination of an impact player on the grass as well as someone that can enhance your culture as well poles explained friday i don t think it can be either or when you talk about a move this size you need to have both and that s what jeffery does we believe he s going to impact us at a high level on the grass but also in the locker room too a wary bears fan might point to the trade as a major risk in theory it is sending future high value picks elsewhere in exchange for a talent who can instantly upgrade an area of need for the bears is a win now move that carries the possibility of mortgaging the future for the present much of that fear exists in a hypothetical realm though first round picks are only as valuable as the players on which a team spends its selections poles believes his front office has proven itself worthy of making such a move and he expects his personnel department to capitalize on the team s remaining picks one thing i want to hit i know it s kind of a joke that kind of goes around but like f them picks is a big thing poles said referencing the los angeles rams win now style of roster construction that s really not what we re about i know it took a lot to get this done but we absolutely believe that the draft and bringing young talent is a way that you sustain success around here i m challenging myself and our crew for the picks that we do have we have to hit we have to be great with our undrafted free agent process and whatever tier of free agency we re working in which will have constraints we got to hit there too we have a good track record it continues to get better every year so i ve got a lot of faith that we ll be able to get that done and again sustain success those are largely tomorrow s problems it s week 8 in the 2026 season the bears are 5 2 in a highly competitive nfc north and they need to be as strong as possible if they hope to repeat as division champions poles made the simmons trade with this in mind and as the paperwork was filed to the league office in new york simmons quickly understood the intent my game my passion my energy my leadership i can only help this team even more than what it s got he said this is a great locker room from quarterback all the way down my job is not trying to come in here and be nothing than but myself i m excited to be able to help this team compete for a championship that s every team in the nfl s goal i think right now with the way this team has been competing i ve been watching these guys from afar it s a great team great locker room and i m excited to do my part to help this team get to its goal

material_news_signals.body_text: landover md donna summer 39 s 34 last dance 34 was being played by a tailgater in the parking lot of northwest stadium when i pulled in sunday afternoon not kidding perhaps the dj was prescient knowing the stakes of what was otherwise a forgettable matchup between washington and philadelphia the two worst teams in the nfc east playing a game that was somehow not flexed into the sun by nbc a commanders loss to the jv eagles sunday and the doomsday clock ticking louder and louder on dan quinn 39 s future would have been clanging like big ben and for a quarter or so washington coming off a bye and playing against a philly team that lined up without more than a dozen starters including quarterback jalen hurts were horrendous awful the eagles jumped out to a 10 0 lead aided by multiple pre snap penalties from washington 39 s beleaguered offensive line and defensive penalties and dropped passes and passes from quarterback jayden daniels that were either off target or behind his open receivers and mental errors that came by the carload 34 honestly 34 daniels said afterward 34 it was just complete bs the way we started 34 it was so terrible that daniels gathered his offensive unit together in the first half on the sidelines and read them the riot act 34 the coaches could beat a dead horse all they want 34 he said 34 at the end of the day you have to take accountability you have to focus you can 39 t have mental lapses ultimately it 39 s on us 34 then finally the commanders righted themselves the penalties slowed at least to the point where washington put a few scoring drives together quinn got the complementary football he constantly talks about good plays by the defense feeding into scoring drives by the offense luke mccaffrey had his best night of the season returning kicks drew stevens nailed a huge 56 yard field goal late in the first quarter to get the commanders on the board if he 39 d missed the eagles would have taken over near midfield ready to add to their lead and daniels came back from a big hit by eagles linebacker nolan smith late in the first half that knocked the wind out of him in the second half he hit tight end chig okonkwo for 21 yards on a great catch by okonkwo found treylon burks on a double move for a 53 yard strike that set up another stevens field goal and got antonio williams on a 30 yard vertical route in the fourth leading to another stevens 3 pointer rachaad white sealed the game on washington 39 s final drive creasing a zone run for 33 yards to the eagles 39 4 yard line then closing the show with a 1 yard touchdown run with 1 52 left the 27 10 win was daniels 39 first win since 133 this is crazy 133 october 5 2025 against the l a chargers that was almost 13 months ago since then daniels had gone 0 7 1 as the starter what it did was buy the commanders another week there 39 s still so much to clean up with the rams coming to northwest next sunday if washington wasn 39 t in the wretched nfc east it would be out of its misery already and quinn might be out of a job but the commanders are here and thus they 39 re only a half game out of second place and only two games behind the first place giants with 10 games left to play 34 the nfl it 39 s crazy 34 running back austin ekeler said 34 you take it one week at a time and control what you can control i saw the cowboys lost today that 39 s good for the commanders and we won today that 39 s also good for the commanders 34 washington had just one offensive penalty in the second half and got some luck too when eagles kicker jake elliott doinked a 41 yard field goal attempt off the left upright in the fourth philly was only down 16 10 at that point after taking more than seven minutes off the clock on a long drive but the commanders did what they had to do 34 you 39 ve heard me talk a lot about four quarters 34 quinn said 34 i thought tonight we nailed three we need all four that 39 s how it needs to go down 34 quinn said he spent the bye week digging deep into what was causing all the penalties and really digging into finding out what worked on both sides of the ball versus and what didn 39 t he promised a streamlined system that would put washington a step ahead of where it had previously been and then the commanders spent much of the first half shooting themselves in the foot 34 the same stuff that 39 s been showing up all year 34 tackle andrew wylie said defensive end k 39 lavon chaisson one of washington 39 s big free agent pickups in the offseason committed two roughing the passer penalties one made no sense at all as he ragdolled eagles quarterback tanner mckee to the ground well after mckee had let the ball go 34 that one he might have gotten an earful 34 quinn said the second was more dubious as officials determined chaisson 39 s hand made contact with mckee 39 s helmet after mckee had thrown a pass that bounced off the hands of a receiver into washington cornerback trey amos 39 hands the call was at best borderline but chaisson didn 39 t hang his head nor did the defense dorance armstrong had a strip sack of mckee early in the third quarter and defensive end charles omenihu recovered the fumble after the second roughing call chaisson stuffed saquon barkley for no gain on a zone run he came off the edge on the next possession pressuring mckee into an incompletion on the next play he dropped mckee for an 11 yard sack 34 i tried to have that six second mindset and kind of flush it and get on to the next play and not try to just get in turmoil and call my team any more lack of effort or playmaking in general 34 chaisson said six seconds daniels has mentioned that too in another context an average play he says takes about that long to run he has implored his offensive mates just lock in for six seconds if they do that they won 39 t keep having to play from behind the sticks it took smith about six seconds to get around the edge and plant daniels into the grass on the play that appeared to end in another injury for a moment daniels sagged to the ground every commanders player and fan had their heart in their throats because they 39 ve been down that road too much during the 13 months between daniels 39 last victory and his next one everything can change in an instant take the ravens 39 lamar jackson the two time nfl most valuable player was finally back on the field sunday for baltimore in a big game against the bills jackson stepped back to pass on his first play of the game and then his right thumb hit the hand of bills 39 end greg rousseau now jackson 39 s likely out for the season and it 39 s at least possible that he 39 s played his last game in baltimore the commanders are fortunate that their franchise qb rose up off the ground this time and lived to fight another half they took advantage of it six seconds at a time and bought themselves seven more days to hope this article originally appeared in the athletic

material_news_signals.description: If GM Howie Roseman is willing to wheel and deal in the coming weeks, at least one major name won't be on the move. The Eagles will not be trading former Offensive Player of the Year Saquon Barkley.
material_news_signals.body_text: as the eagles losses continue to pile up the nov 10 trade deadline nears begging the question will philadelphia sell its stars if general manager howie roseman is willing to wheel and deal in the coming weeks at least one major name won t be on the move the eagles will not be trading former offensive player of the year saquon barkley nfl network insiders mike garafolo and ian rapoport reported sunday barkley is under contract through the 2028 season in philadelphia making him an attractive trade piece but the eagles are set to retain the star running back amid what is turning out to be a lost season while philly has stumbled to a 2 5 start due to a confluence of poor play injuries a retirement and trades barkley has underperformed in his five games played while missing two games with a hamstring injury the 29 year old rb has tallied 244 yards and a touchdown on 43 carries in those appearances topping out at 80 yards from scrimmage in a game barkley s most recent appearance on monday night against dallas was cut short due to a back issue that resulted from compensating for the hamstring injury that held him out the previous two games barkley logged just nine snaps picking up 71 yards on nine touches the eagles rb said his hamstring came out great after the game but barkley missed most of practice this week before returning on friday he is off the injury report for sunday night s game against washington the eagles have already participated in a trade this season sending center cam jurgens to baltimore earlier this month other players possibly at risk of being dealt by nov 10 are tight end dallas goedert linebacker zack baun and defensive lineman moro ojomo barkley however is staying put as roseman and the eagles look to rebuild on the fly as their season spirals out of control barkley and philly take on the commanders 1 4 1 at 8 20 p m et on sunday

material_news_signals.headline: Buccaneers' Todd Bowles on zero-completion win over Falcons: There's a 'first time for everything'
material_news_signals.description: The Buccaneers outlasted the Falcons in a rain-soaked affair despite Baker Mayfield attempting only three passes and converting on none of them, becoming the second team in the Super Bowl era to win a game without a single completion.
material_news_signals.body_text: conventional wisdom said baker mayfield would need to throw for more than the 64 yards he managed in last week s victory if the buccaneers hoped to begin a winning streak on sunday conventional wisdom was wrong tampa bay instead outlasted the falcons 16 0 in a rain soaked affair at raymond james stadium despite mayfield attempting only three passes and converting on none of them as the bucs became the second team 1974 bills in the super bowl era to win a game without a single completion i have not head coach todd bowles said when asked if he s ever won without a completion per the team s transcript but there is a first time for everything as noted it s the second such occurrence since the league merger but it s certainly a first for bowles who would ve been only 10 years old when the 74 bills accomplished the unthinkable feat a torrential downpour set the stage for such an odd accomplishment the falcons were especially affected by the storm attempting to throw their way through it to disastrous results michael penix tossed three interceptions in the first 18 minutes of the game frequently missing his pass catchers as he delivered a slippery football with little to no authority over its destination tampa bay conversely took to the ground again and again attacking an atlanta defense that entered the weekend fourth against the run i didn t say we were not going to throw the ball the conditions told him that bowles said when asked about game plan discussions with offensive coordinator zac robinson you could see it it s a downpour and the wind was blowing you can kind of see the ball wasn t going anywhere mayfield attempted his first pass with 7 53 remaining in the first quarter nearly a 28 yard touchdown that ted hurst dropped after throwing another pass with 4 10 left in the opening frame he wouldn t record another one until his third snap of the third quarter that was it there was a dropback in the second quarter during which mayfield had the ball slip out his grasp while trying to throw a good representation of the sloppiness that contributed to five fumbles and three ints between the teams but it was otherwise all runs the buccaneers simply didn t need to take any of the risks involved with airing it out further their defense was that stifling and their running game was that dominant bucky irving and kenneth gainwell gashed the falcons for a combined 310 rushing yards on 52 attempts on tampa bay s lone td drive the two combined to go 90 yards on six carries with both breaking off big runs irving for 46 and gainwell for 28 including mayfield s 14 rushing yards the buccaneers set a new franchise single game record with 324 it s winning that s the way i think about it mayfield said we won it s getting our guys lined up making sure we are running the right run plays obviously ball security is crucial in these conditions we had some early ones we decided to go to the shotgun and pistol sets it s just easier to receive the snaps instead of it coming back through your hands under center so going from there and just trying to manage the game it s time management and just trying to bleed the clock as much as possible just get everybody on the same page and go from there that s my job in these conditions and listen i will do whatever it takes to win that s all that matters to me offensive lineman luke goedeke who helped pave the way for tampa bay s historic rushing performance said of mayfield only attempting three passes yeah i mean it s great it s just a testament to the offense the o line the tight ends the wide receivers running backs it s just everyone doing their job and bake he hands off a mean ball so really hats off to him as well the buccaneers have now won two straight both against divisional opponents to inch back to 3 5 they re right in the thick of it in the nfc south knotted in the win column with the falcons 3 5 and panthers who sit atop the standings at 3 4 they ve still got a long ways to go and surely mayfield will be called on to pass a lot more than he did on sunday moving forward but the potential turnaround has begun on the strength of a punishing run game we did a lot to dig ourselves out of it bowles said of being back in contention for the division we re still in it being 3 5 not being 500 or anything else i told them to keep their shovels close because we have a lot more digging to do but it gets us back in it

material_news_signals.description: The Indianapolis Colts lost their fourth straight game, this one in embarrassing fashion in a 42-7 loss in Jacksonville.
material_news_signals.body_text: it s getting dark early in indianapolis the colts suffered another embarrassing loss on sunday getting their doors blown off 42 7 by rival jacksonville already amid a teardown it s the type of loss that puts more jobs in question coach shane steichen sits in the crosshairs after indy already parted ways with general manager chris ballard and traded away quenton nelson and deforest buckner it s one thing to be 2 6 it s a different matter to get walloped by a rival in disheartening fashion for a fourth straight loss it wasn t good enough flat out wasn t good enough steichen said via the indianapolis star we got outcoached we got outplayed and we ve got to freaking learn from our mistakes in a hurry the effort and the energy has to be there every week if not you re going to get beat like that the colts played like a team whose players know there is no coming back this season missed tackles botched offensive plays leading to turnovers ineffective quarterback play questionable play calls everything was a mess those issues fall squarely on steichen clearly i ve got to do a better job plain and simple steichen said it starts with me as the head coach i ve got to do a better job to get these guys ready to go that wasn t it today the question is how much longer steichen is the head coach clearly he couldn t get his players ready for a division opponent after the week of trades might indy be better served severing ties now than waiting until the new year i m focused on getting better steichen said that s what i m focused on right now beyond steichen s future the colts have several big questions between now and next week jonathan taylorcould be traded the rb had a big 19 yard run out of the gate on sunday but did little else the rest of the way earning 23 rushing yards on eight carries and a fumble on a botched trick play the colts may not have wanted to put taylor in harm s way with the trade deadline looming but once indy was down big there was little point in putting more tread on his tires regardless of how things play out then there is daniel jones who has struggled mightily this season on sunday he completed 19 of 28 passes for 144 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions before being sat in the blowout jones play has sunk like a rock this season he has missed passes and gets rattled any time there is pressure he material_news_signals.headline: Buccaneers' Todd Bowles on zero-completion win over Falcons: There's a 'first time for everything'
material_news_signals.description: The Buccaneers outlasted the Falcons in a rain-soaked affair despite Baker Mayfield attempting only three passes and converting on none of them, becoming the second team in the Super Bowl era to win a game without a single completion.
material_news_signals.body_text: conventional wisdom said baker mayfield would need to throw for more than the 64 yards he managed in last week s victory if the buccaneers hoped to begin a winning streak on sunday conventional wisdom was wrong tampa bay instead outlasted the falcons 16 0 in a rain soaked affair at raymond james stadium despite mayfield attempting only three passes and converting on none of them as the bucs became the second team 1974 bills in the super bowl era to win a game without a single completion i have not head coach todd bowles said when asked if he s ever won without a completion per the team s transcript but there is a first time for everything as noted it s the second such occurrence since the league merger but it s certainly a first for bowles who would ve been only 10 years old when the 74 bills accomplished the unthinkable feat a torrential downpour set the stage for such an odd accomplishment the falcons were especially affected by the storm attempting to throw their way through it to disastrous results michael penix tossed three interceptions in the first 18 minutes of the game frequently missing his pass catchers as he delivered a slippery football with little to no authority over its destination tampa bay conversely took to the ground again and again attacking an atlanta defense that entered the weekend fourth against the run i didn t say we were not going to throw the ball the conditions told him that bowles said when asked about game plan discussions with offensive coordinator zac robinson you could see it it s a downpour and the wind was blowing you can kind of see the ball wasn t going anywhere mayfield attempted his first pass with 7 53 remaining in the first quarter nearly a 28 yard touchdown that ted hurst dropped after throwing another pass with 4 10 left in the opening frame he wouldn t record another one until his third snap of the third quarter that was it there was a dropback in the second quarter during which mayfield had the ball slip out his grasp while trying to throw a good representation of the sloppiness that contributed to five fumbles and three ints between the teams but it was otherwise all runs the buccaneers simply didn t need to take any of the risks involved with airing it out further their defense was that stifling and their running game was that dominant bucky irving and kenneth gainwell gashed the falcons for a combined 310 rushing yards on 52 attempts on tampa bay s lone td drive the two combined to go 90 yards on six carries with both breaking off big runs irving for 46 and gainwell for 28 including mayfield s 14 rushing yards the buccaneers set a new franchise single game record with 324 it s winning that s the way i think about it mayfield said we won it s getting our guys lined up making sure we are running the right run plays obviously ball security is crucial in these conditions we had some early ones we decided to go to the shotgun and pistol sets it s just easier to receive the snaps instead of it coming back through your hands under center so going from there and just trying to manage the game it s time management and just trying to bleed the clock as much as possible just get everybody on the same page and go from there that s my job in these conditions and listen i will do whatever it takes to win that s all that matters to me offensive lineman luke goedeke who helped pave the way for tampa bay s historic rushing performance said of mayfield only attempting three passes yeah i mean it s great it s just a testament to the offense the o line the tight ends the wide receivers running backs it s just everyone doing their job and bake he hands off a mean ball so really hats off to him as well the buccaneers have now won two straight both against divisional opponents to inch back to 3 5 they re right in the thick of it in the nfc south knotted in the win column with the falcons 3 5 and panthers who sit atop the standings at 3 4 they ve still got a long ways to go and surely mayfield will be called on to pass a lot more than he did on sunday moving forward but the potential turnaround has begun on the strength of a punishing run game we did a lot to dig ourselves out of it bowles said of being back in contention for the division we re still in it being 3 5 not being 500 or anything else i told them to keep their shovels close because we have a lot more digging to do but it gets us back in it
